note: Nvidia company file from its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026 (Q2 fiscal 2027), filed August 26, 2026, and the CEO certification filed with it (Exhibit 31.1). Read in a browser on sec.gov; every quote checked as an exact substring of the document text with whitespace collapsed. Table rows are quoted as the text runs them together.

document_meta.title: NVIDIA Corporation Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026

signals.label: Data Center revenue
signals.quote: Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion, up 117% from a year ago and up 18% sequentially, driven by the ramp of our Blackwell Ultra infrastructure.

signals.label: Largest direct customer's share of revenue
signals.quote: For the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, one direct customer represented 16% of total revenue, which was primarily attributable to the Compute & Networking segment.

signals.label: Supply and capacity commitments
signals.quote: We have significantly increased our supply and capacity commitments from $119 billion last quarter to $279 billion as of July 26, 2026 to meet future demand.

signals.label: Revenue from customers headquartered outside the US
signals.quote: Revenue from sales to customers headquartered outside of the United States accounted for 38% and 30% of total revenue for the second quarter and first half of fiscal year 2027, respectively
